name: Read info
summary: Reads the measurement info of an MNE-Python Raw MEG/EEG file and writes it to info.txt, with a summary of acquisition parameters and 2D/3D sensor and head-point plots.
description: Utility that loads an MNE raw .fif file, writes the full raw.info to a text file and adds to the brainlife product the channel types, sampling frequency and other key parameters, plus 2D montage, 3D electrode and digitised head-point figures when positions are available. Use it to inspect a recording's metadata before choosing preprocessing settings. It does not modify the data.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG recording in MNE raw .fif format.

outputs.description: info.txt with the text dump of the raw data info attribute.

citations.text: Hayashi S., Caron B. A., Heinsfeld A. S. et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
